title: test-0083-MAT-POLYNOMIALS
passage: Rohan and Meera were helping their teacher organize the school math fair. They found a box labeled 'Polynomials' containing various wooden shapes and cards. Rohan picked up a card with the expression 1/x + 2 and asked if it belonged in the polynomial box. Meera shook her head, explaining that a polynomial must have non-negative integer exponents for its variables, so this expression is not a polynomial. Next, they looked at a constant block labeled '7'. Rohan argued its degree was one, but Meera corrected him, noting that any non-zero constant polynomial has a degree of zero. They then examined a quadratic card, x^2 - 5x + 6. Rohan calculated the sum of its zeroes using the formula -b/a, arriving at 5. Finally, they checked a card with the factor (x - 3). Meera reminded him that according to the factor theorem, if (x - 3) is a factor of a polynomial p(x), then p(3) must equal zero. They realized that understanding these rules was essential for their project. By carefully checking the degree of constants, identifying valid polynomial forms, and applying the correct relations between zeroes and coefficients, they successfully sorted all the materials for the fair.
